description: Repair hull & armor at a docked station (heals up to 100 hull HP x ship tier per call (armor heals 75 % of that on top, own rate; execute_action REPAIR has the same cap), repeat until full; stops when funds run out). Cost: 10 CWM per hull point and 5 CWM per armor point actually repaired (a mixed hull+armor repair therefore averages below 10 CWM per HP), multiplied by ship tier (T0 0.6, T1 1.2 up to T5 2.0) and the station repair multiplier, then reduced by your CSMC reputation discount (up to 15 %) and by the ARMOR_REPAIR_OPS/SHIP_REPAIR/BIOSCIENCE skills (they lower the CWM cost). The reply shows the calculation in price_info.
